record.question: What remains unverified for Sonora Pass to Leavitt Lake Trail junction?
record.reason: The selected approach has a sourced bidirectional graph; atomic mileage, return itinerary, shoreline paths, individual campsites and current conditions remain unknown. Source destination mileages may refer to a different precise endpoint. The PCT follows the Emigrant/Hoover divide; this is not a claim that every segment is in Emigrant or that Emigrant permission covers Hoover. Jurisdiction, PCT permit applicability and a continuation to Leavitt Lake, Leavitt Peak, Dorothy Lake or Yosemite need separate review. Parking-to-south-side highway crossing geometry is not included.
